newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turkish-Romanian bank profit jumps in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Turkish-Romanian bank profit jumps in 1996.

text.p: Romania's Banca Turco-Romana SA said on Friday its gross profit soared to 43.2 billion lei last year from 9.16 billion in 1995.
The bank's 1996 profit after taxes was 32.27 billion lei, sharply up from 9.16 billion the previous year, Banca Turco-Romana said in a statement.
It said total assets expanded to 360.1 billion lei at end-1996 from 179.3 billion a year before.
Figures reported were audited by Coopers & Lybrand in accordance with international accounting standards.

The bank, launched in May 1994 as a joint-venture between Turkey's Bayindir Holding and Romania's state-owned Banca Comerciala Romana SA, aims to promote the growth of trade between Romania and Turkey.
Its share capital, controlled by Bayindir Holding, was 28.45 billion lei at end-1996.
